scheme_name: Schedule Caste Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
other_conditions: Must be a regular student in classes 6 to 8 in schools run by the Central Government, State Government, Municipalities or schools recognized by the Department of Education.
Student's guardians should not be income taxpayers (if parent(s) are alive).
Student must not be receiving any other scholarship or allowance for study from central, state or public sources.
Student must not have failed in the lower class in the last session.
If the student fails any examination, the scholarship will be stopped and the student must reapply after passing the class.
benefits_summary: SC boy students receive Rs. 75 per month; SC girl students receive Rs. 125 per month.
application_link: Applicant to log in to RajSSO Portal using his/her SSOID. If SSOID is not available then the applicant must first register on RajSSO Portal to create SSOID and update the SSO profile at first login. After successful authentication/login and updation of the SSOID profile, select the scheme name, select his/her name, the bank account and fill in personal details. Upload the required document and click the “SUBMIT” button.
